entries.id: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-金色海灘與浪線:0
legacyIds: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-金色海灘與浪線:0
entries.en: golden sandy beach edge, shallow clear seawater, thin transparent receding wave line across wet sand, clean waterline, open seaside ground plane, smooth beach surface
entries.desc: 高頻好用的海邊場景，重點是金色沙灘、透明淺水、薄薄退潮浪緣、清楚水線與濕潤沙面。

entries.id: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-清澈海灣岩岸:1
legacyIds: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-清澈海灣岩岸:1
entries.en: clear turquoise cove shoreline, pale rocky coast, shallow transparent seawater, irregular coastal stones, cliff wall edge, small inlet waterline, uneven shoreline surface
entries.desc: 以清澈淺藍海水、淺色岩岸與被海水包圍的小海灣為核心，重點是岩石、峭壁邊、水線與不平整岸邊表面，而不是平坦沙灘。

entries.id: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-岩洞感海灣淺灘:2
legacyIds: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-岩洞感海灣淺灘:2
entries.en: rocky seaside cove with cave-like cliff openings, shallow crystalline water, irregular stone shoreline, recessed rock wall, coastal rock textures, uneven shallow-water edge
entries.desc: 岩壁上帶有洞口或凹陷感的海灣淺灘，重點是碎石、淺水、凹入岩壁、岩面材質與不規則水邊。

entries.id: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-草地與樹木:3
legacyIds: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-草地與樹木:3
entries.en: small grassy park patch, uneven lawn texture, scattered tree trunks at varied depths, low shrubs, ground-level natural surface, off-center tree edge
entries.desc: 小型草地與樹木邊緣，重點是不均勻草皮、不同距離的樹幹、低矮灌木與偏側樹木錨點。

entries.id: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-廣闊草原平原與天空:4
legacyIds: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-廣闊草原平原與天空:4
entries.zh: 戶外：廣闊草原平原與天空
entries.en: wide open grassland plain, low meadow grasses and wild plants, flat horizon line, expansive open sky, distant tree line, spacious countryside field
entries.desc: 廣闊草原與平原感的戶外場景，重點是低矮草叢、野生植物、平坦地平線、大面積天空與遠方樹線。

entries.id: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-向日葵花田:5
legacyIds: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-向日葵花田:5
entries.en: sunflower field edge, dense sunflower stems, large yellow flower heads, irregular plant clusters broken by leaves, soil path fragment on one side, rural field background
entries.desc: 向日葵花田邊緣，重點是密集花莖、大型黃色花頭、被葉片打斷的不規則植株群、單側土路片段與田野背景。

entries.id: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-霧感森林步道:6
legacyIds: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-霧感森林步道:6
entries.en: forest path edge, dark tree trunks at varied distances, uneven ground, mossy roots, leaf litter, partial trail curve, dense woodland background
entries.desc: 森林步道邊緣，重點是不同距離的樹幹、不平地面、苔蘚樹根、落葉、局部彎曲小徑與密林背景。

entries.id: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-森林營地帳篷營火:7
legacyIds: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-森林營地帳篷營火:7
entries.zh: 戶外：森林營地帳篷營火
entries.en: forest campsite clearing, canvas tent edge, campfire pit, hanging lantern stand, tree trunks at varied depths, leaf-litter ground, asymmetric camp setup
entries.desc: 森林營地的局部戶外場景，重點是帆布帳篷邊、營火盆、吊掛油燈架、不同深度的樹幹、落葉地面與偏側營地配置。

entries.id: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-湖邊木棧道:8
legacyIds: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-湖邊木棧道:8
entries.en: lakeside wooden deck edge, weathered planks, low railing section, calm water surface beside the deck, reeds or shoreline plants on one side, natural bank detail
entries.desc: 湖邊木棧道邊緣，重點是風化木板、低欄杆片段、棧道旁水面、單側蘆葦或岸邊植物與自然岸線細節。

entries.id: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-海邊岩岸:9
legacyIds: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-海邊岩岸:9
entries.en: rocky shoreline edge, irregular stone slabs, tide-pool pockets, rough coastal rock texture, seawater visible beside the rocks, uneven standing surface
entries.desc: 海邊岩岸邊緣，重點是不規則石板、潮池凹洞、粗糙岩面、岩石旁海水與不平整可站立表面。

entries.id: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-沙丘與風痕地景:10
legacyIds: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-沙丘與風痕地景:10
entries.en: sand dune slope, wind-shaped sand ripples, uneven dune ridge, sparse dry grass tufts, open sandy ground plane, off-center crest line
entries.desc: 沙丘坡面與風痕地景，重點是砂紋、不均勻沙脊、稀疏乾草、開闊沙地平面與偏離中心的稜線。

entries.id: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-白色鹽湖乾裂荒漠:11
legacyIds: locations:自然與戶外-nature-outdoors:戶外-白色鹽湖乾裂荒漠:11
entries.zh: 戶外：白色鹽湖乾裂荒漠
entries.en: white salt flat playa edge, cracked salt crust ground, pale polygon surface texture, open dry basin, distant low mountain range, wide blue-sky desert horizon
entries.desc: 白色鹽湖或乾涸 playa 荒漠場景，重點是乾裂鹽殼地面、淡色多邊形表面紋理、開闊乾盆地、遠方低山與寬闊沙漠地平線。
